message.content:
Rewrite the CareerSettings page at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/pages/CareerSettings.tsx to use a tabbed layout instead of a long single-scroll page.

IMPORTANT: Read the FULL existing file first (it's ~800 lines). You MUST preserve ALL existing:
- State variables and their initialization
- Query hooks (config, jobs, subscribers)
- Mutations (save config, toggle job published)
- Helper functions (slugify, isValidHex, handleCompanyNameChange, handleSlugChange, triggerSlugCheck, handleSave, addBenefit, updateBenefit, removeBenefit, toggleJobPublished, copyUrl)
- Types (Benefit, SocialLinks, CareerPageConfig, CareerJob, SlugStatus)
- SlugStatusBadge, ConfigSkeleton, JobsSkeleton components

The ONLY thing changing is the JSX layout. Replace the `<div className="space-y-6">` with a tab system.

## Tab Structure

Use shadcn Tabs from `@/components/ui/tabs` (Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent).

**Tab 1: "Branding"** — Contains:
- Company name + URL slug (with SlugStatusBadge)
- Logo URL
- Brand color picker
- Cover image URL + preview
- Tagline
- Font selector (add a `<Select>` with these options: "Inter", "DM Sans", "Plus Jakarta Sans", "Outfit", "Space Grotesk", "Manrope", "Poppins", "Roboto") — store in existing `font_family` state variable, add it to state if missing
- Publish toggle + preview link
- Save button

**Tab 2: "Content"** — Contains:
- About textarea
- Culture section title + description
- Benefits list (existing add/edit/remove)
- Save button

**Tab 3: "Social & SEO"** — Contains:
- Social links (website, LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, Facebook)
- Meta description + keywords
- Save button

**Tab 4: "Jobs"** — Contains:
- Published jobs table (existing)
- Subscribers count card

**Tab 5: "Advanced"** — Contains:
- Custom CSS textarea with warning
- Custom Domain card (coming soon)

## Tab styling
```tsx
<Tabs defaultValue="branding" className="w-full">
  <TabsList className="w-full justify-start border-b border-border bg-transparent px-0 rounded-none h-auto">
    <TabsTrigger value="branding" className="rounded-none border-b-2 border-transparent data-[state=active]:border-primary data-[state=active]:bg-transparent data-[state=active]:shadow-none px-4 pb-2.5 text-sm">
      Branding
    </TabsTrigger>
    ...
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="branding" className="mt-6">
    ...cards here...
  </TabsContent>
</Tabs>
```

## Rules
- Keep ALL existing logic exactly as-is
- Each tab's "Save" button calls the same `handleSave` function
- The page header (title + Live badge + copy/open buttons) stays ABOVE the tabs
- Add `fontFamily` state if it doesn't exist, wire it into the save payload
- Import `Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent` from `@/components/ui/tabs`
- Import `Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue` for font selector
- After writing, run `cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora" && npm run build` to verify

Build passes cleanly with zero errors. The chunk size warning is pre-existing and unrelated to this change.

Here is a summary of every change made to `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/pages/CareerSettings.tsx`:

**New imports added**
- `Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent` from `@/components/ui/tabs`
- `Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue` from `@/components/ui/select`

**New state variable**
- `fontFamily` — initialized to `"Inter"`, populated from `configData.font_family` in the `useEffect`, and included in the `handleSave` payload as `font_family`.

**New constants/helpers**
- `FONT_OPTIONS` array with the 8 required font names
- `SaveButton` internal component to avoid repeating the save button JSX across tabs

**Layout change only — all logic preserved**
The entire `<div className="space-y-6">` block was replaced with a `<Tabs>` structure. The five tabs are:

| Tab | Value | Cards inside |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Branding | `branding` | Identity (company name, slug, logo, brand color, cover image, tagline, font selector, publish toggle, preview link) |
| Content | `content` | About + Culture & Benefits (culture title, description, benefits list) |
| Social & SEO | `social-seo` | Social Links + SEO (meta description, keywords) |
| Jobs | `jobs` | Email Subscribers count card + Published Jobs table |
| Advanced | `advanced` | Custom CSS + Custom Domain (coming soon) |

The page header (title, Live badge, Copy/Open buttons) and subtitle paragraph remain above the `<Tabs>` component, unchanged.
